suppliers.name: СП ООО "Process and Water Chemicals" (P&WC Specialties, part of P&WC Alliance), Chirchik / Tashkent, Uzbekistan
suppliers.evidence: T-47/2026 ITB section 12 (itb.txt line ~1714): 'chemicals of JV Process and Water Chemicals LLC and Veolia water technologies & solutions (previously Suez WTS) have been industrially tested' at UGCC.
suppliers.notes: Local manufacturer with full water program (BoilGard boiler, CoolGard/IronShield/BiolTrol/Dissolv cooling, MemKare RO, HyCog/HyFloc, FoamSolv/MetKleen) + field service & ChemTrack monitoring (https://pwcspecialties.com/water-treatment/, /service/). CEO Bartolo Renda ex-Veolia/SUEZ/GE Water; COO Khurshid Sadiev previously held senior roles at Uz-Kor Gas Chemical (https://pwcspecialties.com/team/). NBD customs summary: imports 2022-2025 of water-treatment raws (complexing agent, tolyltriazole Na from China, PAM flocculants N632/C6660 China, dispersant), exports BoilGard/MemKare to Turkmenistan, PetroKare to Kazakhstan; partners incl. Prasol Chemicals, Ganga Rasayanie, Lubrizol France (https://en.nbd.ltd/trader/info/NBDX1H137305614).
suppliers.status: INFERENCE: most likely incumbent/strong favourite; not confirmed as contract winner (award notices behind login).

notes.frequency: Water/wastewater-treatment chemicals open tenders seen: T-37/2018 (Aug), T-08/2021 (Feb), T-39/2022 (Jul), T-5/2024 + T-12/2024 + T-22/2024 (Jan-Mar 2024, subjects truncated), T-27/2025 (Feb), T-47/2026 (Nov). INFERENCE: roughly annual to every 1-2 years; no 2019, 2020 or 2023 water-chemical open tender seen in tenderweek listing. Small items (SBS 35%, amine pH corrector, TSP, citric acid) are bought separately via short CS procedures (7-30 days), often domestic-market only.
notes.cancellations_reannouncements: Deadline extensions ('ПРОДЛЕНИЕ') seen for T-12/2019, T-23/2020, CS-196/2021 (SBS), CS-310/19 (extended repeatedly Dec 2019-Oct 2020). No explicit cancellation of a water-chemical tender found. Number of bidders: not found.
eligibility_quirks_seen: 2016: company age >=2 years; 2017 onward: >=6 months; notarized charter/foundation docs; certificate of no reorganization/liquidation/bankruptcy from tax inspection and bank (uz-kor.com arkhiv/111, 591)
Bid in English and Russian; sealed envelope by courier/hand to Tashkent office; docs free on official signed/stamped request letter (T-36/2017)
Exclusion of bidders in litigation with Uz-Kor or with poor performance on prior contracts (CS notices 2017; trend.az 2021)
CS procedures 'due to urgency' limited to Uzbekistan-registered entities (CS-83/2017; CS-133/2026; CS-228/2024 oils per daryo.uz)

T-47/2026 (from ITB): bid bond bank guarantee USD 8 000; manufacturer POA (App.7); 1-month on-site trial of all chemicals except passivation - no payment and no contract if negative; full damage-compensation guarantee letter; product <=2 months old at shipment; DAP Akchalak; 100% payment after delivery; P&WC and Veolia products noted as already industrially tested (INFERENCE: they may effectively have an advantage on the trial).
notes.site_specifics_from_ITB: RO membranes TORAY; cooling tower recirculation 50 000 m3/h, blowdown design/actual 110/50 m3/h; currently also used: non-oxidizing biocide, calcium nitrate 68%, non-ferrous corrosion inhibitor; NaOCl used for disinfection.
